concerns.text: Task T010 [P] aggregates cleaned batch files, but the dependency table lists only T008 as its prerequisite. It actually consumes the output of T009 (post_process.py). Missing this producer‑consumer link creates a potential ordering violation if T010 were scheduled before T009.

Task T007 is marked [P] (parallel‑safe) yet writes to a shared state file `state/projects/PROJ-318-evaluating-the-impact-of-code-generation.yaml`. Concurrent execution of multiple [P] tasks could cause race conditions on this single YAML file, so the [P] tag is unsafe.

Task T014 depends on T011 per the table, but it only needs the raw generation outputs (produced by T008/T009). While not a hard consumer‑before‑producer error, the listed dependency adds an unnecessary ordering constraint and should be updated to depend on T009 (or T010) for clarity.
